name: gallery-modal-accordion
title: Gallery Modal Accordion
description: A row of thin photo strips that widen on hover and open one image large over a blurred page. A title and short description sit in a strip at the foot of the opened photo.
use: A portfolio needs many images in little space but still wants a big single view.
avoid: Only slivers show at rest, so images are hard to judge without hovering each one.
a11y: Photos are click-only images with no alt; Escape closes the overlay but nothing on the strip can be tabbed to. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A horizontal row of narrow vertical image slivers with rounded corners; one sliver widens into a tall rectangle under the cursor. Opened, a single square photo floats over a blurred, darkened copy of the row, with a small caption strip at its base.
behaves: Sliding across the row widens whichever sliver is under the pointer; clicking it opens that photo as a centered square while the row behind blurs and dims. Clicking the backdrop or pressing Escape closes it.
customise: itemsArr holds each image URL, title, description and tags; sliver widths and overlay blur live in the file.
weight: moderate: Eleven remote photos with width animation and a full-screen blurred overlay.
demo: Eleven mountain and nature photos with titles such as Misty Mountain Majesty and Winter Wonderland
issues: Strip images have no alt text; only the opened photo gets a generic alt.
The caption over the opened photo is faint and hard to read.
polishWhy: Distinctive hover accordion and modal reveal; faint captions and no alt text cost a point.
